name: INFRATEL / Zambia National Data Centre (3 national Tier III data centres)
developer: INFRATEL Corporation Zambia Limited / Zambia National Data Centre (government)
notes: Official INFRATEL homepage states 'We have three data centres to back up your data' and lists colocation/cloud/backup/DR services (A-grade operator page); data-centre services page describes physical security (A). PeeringDB org 22678 (B) adds 'three data centres spread over 350KM apart' with geographical redundancy. Parliament records tie ZNDC to three Smart Zambia Phase I data centres (methodology A/B+). Individual site addresses/capacity not published; Kitwe DR site lead recorded under Copperbelt.

name: Paratus Zambia Data Centre (Lusaka)
notes: Official Paratus Zambia page lists data-centre colocation/cloud services (A). DCD 2021-04 (B) reported 1 MW carrier-neutral facility due for completion July 2021; IT-Online/IT News Africa report opening 1 Oct 2021 (B). ITWeb (B) describes ISO-certified 'Tier 3 design' facility. 1 MW is a B-grade media value; 'Tier III by design' is design wording, not Uptime certification. datacentermap lists address 34 Bwinjimfumu Rd, Lusaka (C).

name: Liquid Intelligent Technologies Zambia local cloud (Azure Stack)
notes: Liquid's Azure Stack launch announcement for Zambia (World Teleport reprint, B; methodology grades Liquid's own announcement page A for the Azure Stack claim). Local/hybrid cloud operated from Lusaka; NOT an Azure public region (no hyperscaler public region in Zambia per official provider pages). No public dedicated-DC facility page/address/capacity found.

name: Liquid Intelligent Technologies Zambia new data centre (MoU)
developer: Liquid Intelligent Technologies Zambia / Government of Zambia
notes: 2023 MoU between Liquid and the Zambian government to launch a new data centre (Tech In Africa, Connecting Africa; B). Status is MoU/intent only: no site, permit, power or construction evidence found. Not counted as operational per methodology.

name: Smart Zambia / Huawei National AI Data Centre (MoU)
notes: MoU signed 26 May 2026 (Office of the Vice President, A) for co-investment in a national AI data centre 'on Zambian soil', including joint feasibility study and training of 5,000 ICT professionals by 2028 (Smart Zambia page, A; Kwacha News B). Status MoU/intent only: site not public, no permit/power/construction evidence.

name: INFRATEL Data Centre - Disaster Recovery (Kitwe)
notes: Directory-listed INFRATEL DR facility in Kitwe (colo.exchange, datacenterslist, datacenterplanet, pq.hosting; C-grade, described as operational). PeeringDB org 22678 (B) confirms INFRATEL runs three data centres ~350km apart for geographical redundancy, consistent with a Kitwe DR node. Requires official INFRATEL/council/power confirmation before upgrading grade.
